title: Figure 3.1: Two Types of Cylindrical IECs (Hollow Cathode C-Device and 2-D Gridded)
description: Two line drawings of cylindrical inertial electrostatic confinement devices. Panel (a) shows a glass tube containing alternating hollow cylindrical cathodes and anodes with an end reflector; panel (b) shows a cylindrical cathode grid inside a metal vessel. The caption explains the left is often termed the C-Device and the right, the 2-D gridded version, is often just called 'the' cylindrical IEC.
